categories.titre: 🏦 SASHE: Zakka - Kuɗi da Kayan Ado
categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat At-Tawbah, aya ta 34: 'Wadanda ke tara zinari da azurfa ba su ciyar da su a tafarkin Allah ba, ka yi musu albishir da azaba mai raɗaɗi.'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
Dangane da ruwayar Amr ibn Shu'ayb (Abu Dawud lamba 1563, Ingantacce), Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ga wata mata da 'yarta suna sanye da manyan mundayen zinari guda biyu. Ya ce: 'Kuna fitar da zakkar su?' Ta ce: 'A'a'. Ya ce: 'Kuna son Allah Ya sanya muku mundayen wuta guda biyu a maimakon su?'.

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
• Makarantar Hanafi: Dole ne a fitar da kashi 2.5% na dukan zinarin da ake da shi, amfani da kayan ado baya sauya matsayinsa na biyan zakka.
• Makarantun Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali: An yafewa kayan adon halas na mata biyan zakka. Zinari na zuba jari ko ajiya ne kawai ke biyan haraji.

quiz.question: A cewar makarantar Hanafi, shin kayan adon zinari na mata na biyan zakka?
quiz.explication: Makarantar Hanafi tana buƙatar kashi 2.5% na dukan zinarin da ake da shi: amfani da kayan ado baya canza yanayinsa na biyan zakka.

quiz.question: Wadanne makarantun fiqh ne suka yafewa kayan adon halas na mata biyan zakka?
quiz.explication: Zinari na zuba jari ko ajiya ne kawai ake haraji a wurin Maliki, Shafi'i, da Hanbali.

quiz.question: A cikin hadisin da Abu Dawud ya ruwaito, me matar da Manzon Allah ﷺ ya tambaya take sanye da shi?
quiz.explication: Manzon Allah ﷺ ya tambaye ta ko tana biyan zakkar su, kafin gargaɗi kan mundayen wuta.

categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat Al-An'am, aya ta 141: 'Ku biya hakkin ta ranar girbin ta.'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
An ruwaito daga Jabir (Muslim lamba 981), Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: 'Abin da ruwan sama ya shayar ko kuma magudanar ƙasa, ana bin zakkar kashi goma (10%). Abin da aka shayar da na'ura, ana bin rabin kashi goma (5%).' An sanya Nisab a kan Wasaq 5 (kimanin kg 653).

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
Biredi ɗaya kan ƙimar shayarwa. Dangane da dabbobi, yarjejeniyar Abu Bakr ta hukuma (Al-Bukhari lamba 1454) ta sanya adadin tumaki: daga 40 zuwa 120 tumaki = rago 1 da ake bi. Ƙasa da tumaki 40, babu zakka.

quiz.question: Wace ƙima ce ta zakka ke shiga kan amfanin gona da ruwan sama ya shayar da su?
quiz.explication: Cikakken kashi goma (10%) ne ake biya idan ruwan sama ne; rabin kashi goma (5%) idan da na'ura ne.

quiz.question: Guda nawa na tumaki ya kamata mutum ya mallaka kafin zakkar dabbobi ta zama wajibi?
quiz.explication: Ƙasa da 40 babu zakka; daga 40 zuwa 120 rago ɗaya ne ake biya.

quiz.question: Menene kima ko nauyin Nisab na amfanin gona kimanin?
quiz.explication: Nisab na noma an sanya shi a kan Wasaq 5, wato kimanin kg 653.

categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat An-Nissa, aya ta 11: Rarraba rabon gado ba ya zuwa sai bayan aiwatar da sharadi: '...bayan cika wassiya ko biyan basussuka.'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
An ruwaito daga Salamah ibn al-Akwah (Al-Bukhari lamba 2289), an kawo gawar wani mutum wajen Manzon Allah ﷺ domin ya yi masa sallah. Ya tambaya: 'Shin ya bar bashi?' Suka ce: 'Ee, dinari uku'. Ya ce: 'Ku yi wa ɗan'uwan ku sallah (ni ba zan yi masa ba)'. Har sai wani sahabi ya ɗauki alhakin biyan bashin.

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
• Basussuka: Fifiko mafi girma akan gado da wassiya. A wajen Malikiyya da Hanbaliyya, suna rage adadin dukiyar da ake cirewa zakka.
• Kuɗin da ake bin mutane: Idan za a iya karɓowa (mai bashi yana da hali), makarantar Hanafi tana sanya zakka kowace shekara, yayin da makarantar Maliki ke buƙatar biyan sau ɗaya lokacin karɓowa.

quiz.question: A cewar hadisin Salamah ibn al-Akwah, dinari nawa mamacin yake bi?
quiz.explication: Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ƙi yin sallah a kansa har sai da wani sahabi ya karɓi biyan waɗannan dinari 3.

quiz.question: Menene dole ne a fara da shi kafin a raba gado?
choix: Babu komai, rabon yana zuwa nan take
quiz.explication: Surat An-Nissa aya 11: Rarrabawa ba ya zuwa sai bayan cika wassiya da biyan basussuka.

quiz.question: Game da kuɗin da ake bin mutane da ake iya karɓowa, wace makaranta ce ke sanya zakka kowace shekara?
quiz.explication: Makarantar Maliki tana buƙatar biya sau ɗaya lokacin karɓowa, ba kamar Hanafi ba.

categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat An-Nissa, aya ta 11: 'Ga abin da Allah Ya umarce ku game da 'ya'yan ku: ga namiji rabon da ya yi daidai da na mata biyu.'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
An ruwaito daga Ibn Abbas (Al-Bukhari lamba 6732, Muslim lamba 1615), Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: 'Ku ba wa masu hakki rabon su (Fara'idh). Abin da ya rage bayan haka yana zuwa ne ga namijin da ya fi kusa da mamaci.'

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
Cikakken amincewa kan rabon biyu da ɗaya. Wannan doka tana tafiya ne da wajabcin ciyarwa (Nafaqah) da ke kan namiji shi kaɗai. Mace tana riƙe da nata rabon duka domin amfaninta na sirri ba tare da wajabcin ciyar da gida ba. Wadanda zasu iya gada sun haɗa da 'ya'ya, iyaye, 'yan uwa (maza, mata, kawunni, da sauransu) da kuma mata ko miji mai rai.

quiz.question: A cewar Alkur'ani (An-Nissa aya 11), wane rabon ɗa ne idan aka kwatanta da na 'yar?
quiz.explication: "Ga namiji rabon da ya yi daidai da na mata biyu" — tushen rabon shine 2 zuwa 1.

quiz.question: A cewar hadisin Ibn Abbas, wa abin ke komawa bayan an raba kason da aka sani?
choix: Ga namijin da ya fi kusa da mamaci
Ana raba shi daidai ga kowa
quiz.explication: "Abin da ya rage bayan haka yana zuwa ne ga namijin da ya fi kusa da mamaci" — wannan shine asabin.

quiz.question: Wane wajabcin kuɗi ne ya halasta rabon 2 zuwa 1 ga maza?
quiz.explication: Namiji yana da alhakin kuɗi na gida; mace tana riƙe da rabonta ba tare da wajabcin ciyarwa ba.

categories.titre: 💡 SASHE: Gado Ba Tare da Yara Ba (Kalâlah)
categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat An-Nissa, aya ta 12: 'Idan mutum namiji ko mace ya mutu ba shi da magaji na kai tsaye (Kalâlah), yana da ɗan'uwa ko 'yar'uwa (ta wurin uwa), to kowannen su yana da kashi shida (1/6). Idan sun fi biyu, to suna raba kashi uku (1/3).'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
Lokacin da aka tambaye shi ma'anar Kalâlah, Halifa Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (wanda sahabbai suka amince da shi) ya ce: 'Kalâlah shine wanda ba shi da zuriya (yafu) ko uba/kaka kai tsaye.'

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
A batun Kalâlah, 'yan uwa ta wurin uwa suna gado daidai tsakanin maza da mata (babu bambancin rabon 2 zuwa 1). Amma 'yan uwa na uba da uwa suna ɗaukar abin da ya rage a matsayin magada masu zuwa baya (Asabah).

quiz.question: Yaya Halifa Abu Bakr ya bayyana Kalâlah?
choix: Wanda ba shi da zuriya ko uba kai tsaye
quiz.explication: Babu yafiya, babu uba, babu kaka — wannan shine ma'anar da sahabbai suka amince da ita.

quiz.question: A batun Kalâlah, ta yaya ake raba gado tsakanin 'yan uwa ta wurin uwa?
choix: Rabo ɗaya daidai tsakanin maza da mata
quiz.explication: Wannan shine keɓaɓɓen banbanci ga dokar 2 zuwa 1 ta saba.

quiz.question: Idan 'yan uwa ta wurin uwa sun fi biyu, wane rabon ne suke raba tsakanin su?
quiz.explication: Idan biyu ko ƙasa da haka, kashi shida ne ga kowa; idan sun fi haka, suna raba kashi uku (1/3).

categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat Al-Baqarah, aya ta 180: 'An wajabta muku, idan mutuwa ta zo wa ɗayanku kuma ya bar dukiya, yin wassiya ga iyayensa da na kusa da shi...'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
An ruwaito daga Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (Al-Bukhari lamba 2744, Muslim lamba 1628), Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce masa lokacin da yake jinya kuma yana son ya ba da dukiyarsa duka sadaka: 'Ka ba da kashi ɗaya bisa uku (1/3). Kuma 1/3 yana da yawa sosai. Barin magadan ka da wadata ya fi kyau da barinsu talakawa suna roƙon mutane.'

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
Cikakken amincewa: Wasiyya ta haramta ga magaji na halas (sai dai idan sauran magada sun amince bayan mutuwar mutum), kuma iyakar ta ita ce kashi ɗaya bisa uku (1/3) na jimlar dukiya bayan an cire basussuka. Manhajar tana kulle duk wani abin da ya wuce wannan doka ta atomatik.

quiz.question: Menene iyakar wucewa ta Wassiya idan aka kwatanta da jimlar dukiya?
quiz.explication: Cikakken amincewar makarantu huɗu: kashi ɗaya bisa uku (1/3) iyakar ta, bayan an biya basussuka.

quiz.question: Me Manzon Allah ﷺ ya mayar wa Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas wanda ya son ba da dukiyarsa duka sadaka?
choix: "Ba da kashi 1/3, kuma 1/3 yana da yawa sosai"
quiz.explication: Ya ƙara da cewa: barin magadan ka da wadata ya fi kyau da barinsu talakawa suna roƙo.

quiz.question: Shin za a iya yi wa magaji wassiya ta wani rabon gado?
choix: A'a, sai dai idan sauran magada sun amince bayan mutuwa
quiz.explication: Wassiya ga magaji ta haramta sai an sami amincewar dukan magada bayan mutuwa.

categories.titre: 📿 SASHE: Bibiyar Ayyuka na Yau da Kullum
categories.texte:
✨ SASHE NA A: TUSHEN ALKUR'ANI
Surat Al-Hashr, aya ta 18: 'Ya ku wadanda suka yi imani! Ku ji tsoro Allah. Kowane rai ya kalli abin da ya gabatar don gobe.'

✨ SASHE NA B: HADISI MAI INGANCI
• Game da Kwanakin Fari (At-Tirmidhi lamba 761, Ingantacce): Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: 'Idan za ka yi azumin kwanaki uku a wata, ka yi ranar 13, 14, da 15.' Azumin waɗannan kwanaki yana da lada kamar azumin rayuwa duka.
• Game da sallolin nafila (Muslim lamba 728): Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: 'Wanda ya yi raka'a goma sha biyu (12) na nafila kowace rana, Allah Zai gina masa gida a Aljanna.'

✨ SASHE NA C: FIQH NA MAKARANTU HUƊU (SUNNAH)
Ammancewa kan falalar sallolin nafila na Rawatib da azumin kwanakin fari, waɗanda suke manyan kayan aiki na tsarkake rai kullum.

quiz.question: Wadanne kwanaki ne na wata suka dace da "Kwanakin Fari" da aka ba da shawarar azumtar su?
quiz.explication: At-Tirmidhi ya ruwaito: azumin waɗannan kwanaki uku yana da lada kamar azumin rayuwa duka.

quiz.question: Raka'o'in nafila nawa na yau da kullum ke da alƙawarin gida a Aljanna?
quiz.explication: Muslim ya ruwaito: raka'a goma sha biyu (12) na Rawatib kowace rana.

quiz.question: Wace aya ce a Surat Al-Hashr ke cewa kowane rai ya kalli abin da ya gabatar don gobe?
quiz.explication: "Kowane rai ya kalli abin da ya gabatar don gobe."

langue_arabe.sous_titre: Mataki bayan mataki: haruffa, ƙamus, sauyawa, nahawu, da kuma karanta rubututtuka.
langue_arabe.avertissement_audio: Bayani da aka rubuta na taimako ne amma baya maye gurbin sauraro: yi aiki da mai magana da harshen ko rikodin sauti idan zai yiwu, musamman ga haruffan da ba su da kamanni.

lettres.son: Doguwar wasali « a », kamar a cikin « fari » mai tsawo. Tana aiki kuma a matsayin madogara ga Hamza.
Kamar « b » na Turanci ko Hausa.
Kamar « th » na Turanci a « think ».
Numfashi mai zafi daga zurfin maƙogoro.
Kamar « kh » ko hanci mai tsauri.
Kamar « th » na Turanci a « this ».
Sigar « th » mai nauyi da kauri.
Sauti mai fitowa daga zurfin maƙogoro ba tare da iska mai yawa ba.
« k » mai fitowa daga zurfin maƙogoro.
Sauti mai sauƙi, kamar « h » na Turanci.

etapes.source: Jami'ar Madina, Littafi na 2, Darasi na 1: Al-Fi'l al-Madhi (abubuwan da suka wuce) — duba Ilimin Musulunci/Jami'ar Madina...

temps.note_pedagogique: Lokacin nan gaba baya canza sauyawar kalma: yana ƙara harafi ne kawai a gaban lokacin yanzu. سَـ (sa-) don nan gaba na kusa — wanda aka nuna anan. سَوْفَ (sawfa) don nan gaba mai nisa.
Umarni yana zuwa ne kawai ga wanda ake magana da shi (« kai », « ku »).

regles_type_verbe.regle: Idan harafi na biyu daga ƙarshe yana da damma, hamzar umarni tana ɗaukar damma.
Idan tana da fatha ko kasra, hamza tana ɗaukar kasra.
Ga wasu nau'ukan kalmomi, ba a buƙatar ƙarin hamza.

temps.note_temporelle: Umarni da hani ba su da wani lokaci na musamman na da ko na gaba.

temps.note_temporelle: Hani yana nuna dakatarwa daga abu.
